blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Achieving spatial alignment between whole-slide images(WSIs) across stains is essential for integrating morphology and molecular information, yet it remains challenging due to extreme resolution, tissue fragmentation, and large nonlinear deformations. Conventional registration pipelines depend on global pre-alignment and spatial consistency, which often collapse under such distortions. We present SAR2Net, a framework that learns spatially anchored representations and reformulates cross-stain alignment as a region-level feature retrieval problem. Instead of estimating explicit transformations, SAR2Net learns pointwise representations encoding the relative spatial relationships to tissue landmarks. Given landmarks and arbitrary coordinates, it predicts spatially anchored features that serve as deformation-invariant descriptors of tissue topology. A twostage retrieval framework then establishes correspondences between slides, even when global alignment is infeasible. Experiments on biopsy-oriented HE-IHC datasets show that SAR2Net achieves robust region-level alignment under severe tissue distortions, outperforming previous methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.
blocks.zh: 实现覆盖污点的全滑行图像(WSI)之间的空间对接,对于整合形态学和分子信息至关重要,但由于极端分辨率、组织分解和大型非线性变形,它仍然具有挑战性。 常规登记管道取决于全球预先调整和空间一致性,而这种调整往往会因这种扭曲而崩溃。 我们介绍SAR2Net,这是一个学习空间定位表述并重新确定跨相色调一致性的框架,是区域一级的特征检索问题。 SAR2Net没有估计明显的变异,而是学习指向表示,将相对空间关系与组织地标编码. 鉴于地标和任意坐标,它预测了作为组织地貌的变形-变异描述符的空间定位地貌。 然后,一个两阶段检索框架建立幻灯片之间的对应,即使全球对齐不可行。 对面向活检的HE-IHC数据集的实验表明,SAR2Net在严重的组织扭曲下实现了强烈的区域级对接,比以往的方法表现优异. 代码见https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Histopathological examination is the gold standard for cancer diagnosis [ 6 ] . In pathology, tissue sections are stained using different dyes to reveal complementary biological information. Hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining highlights tissue morphology, while immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining exposes molecular expression patterns. To jointly interpret morphological and molecular information, HE and IHC slides are typically prepared from adjacent sections of the same tissue, motivating the problem of cross-stain correspondence in computational pathology.
blocks.zh: 组织病理学检查是癌症诊断的金本位[6]. 在病理学中,组织部分被用不同的染料来染色来揭示互补的生物信息. 血氧林和eosin(HE)的染色突出组织形态,而免疫史化学染色暴露出分子表达模式. 为了共同解释形态学和分子信息,HE和IHC幻灯片一般由同个组织的相邻部分来制取,引发了计算病理学中的交叉相通问题.

blocks.en: Most existing approaches treat this problem as an image registration task, aiming to estimate a spatial transformation that aligns one slide with another. Given the gigapixel scale and stain heterogeneity of WSIs, registration is often performed in a multi-stage process, starting with coarse alignment at low magnification, followed by non-rigid refinement at higher resolutions. The methods typically rely on intensity-based optimization of similarity metrics ( e.g . MI, NCC, NGF), or feature descriptors matching. Recent works combine both strategies in hybrid pipelines [ 11 , 28 ] , while others employ neural networks to directly predict transformation parameters [ 29 , 25 ] . Such methods with hierarchical designs perform well when a consistent global correspondence exists between slides.
blocks.zh: 多数现行做法将这一问题视为图像登记任务,目的是估算一个幻灯片与另一个幻灯片相匹配的空间变换。 鉴于WSI的千兆像素尺度和污点异质性,注册工作往往在多阶段进行,首先在低放大时进行粗度对接,后在高分辨率下进行非刚性改进. 这些方法通常依赖于基于强度的类似度量的优化(例如. MI, NCC, NGF),或特征描述符相匹配. 近期的作品结合了混合管线中的两种策略[11,28],而其他作品则使用神经网络直接预测转化参数[29,25]. 当幻灯片之间有一致的全球对应关系时,这种具有分级设计的方法运作良好。

blocks.en:
However, all these methods rely on the assumption that a coarse pre-alignment can be successfully established first.
This assumption often breaks down in histopathological slides with fragmented or heavily deformed tissue structures. In many biopsy-derived WSIs, tissues appear as multiple disconnected fragments or elongated strips that undergo bending, tearing, or nonlinear distortion during sectioning. As shown in Fig. 1 , adjacent HE–IHC slides of such samples frequently exhibit inconsistent spatial layouts, missing regions, or non-overlapping tissue parts, making global alignment unreliable. These complex structural discontinuities are common [ 1 ] in real-world pathology data but are rarely represented in existing benchmarks. When large portions of tissue cannot be coarsely aligned, conventional registration pipelines typically collapse, yielding unstable or meaningless correspondences.
blocks.zh:
然而,所有这些方法都依赖于一个假设,即可以先成功建立粗糙的预调.
这种假设常常在组织结构支离破碎或严重畸形的病理滑行中被打破. 在许多活体解剖衍生的WSI中,组织出现为多片断裂片或长条,在分解过程中会发生弯曲,撕裂或非线性扭曲. 如图1所示,这些样本的相邻HE-IHC幻灯片往往显示空间布局不一致、缺失区域或组织部位不重叠,使全球对接不可靠。 这些复杂的结构不连续现象在现实世界的病理学数据中是常见的[1],但在现有的基准中却很少出现. 当大片组织无法粗连时,常规登记管道通常会倒塌,产生不稳定或毫无意义的通信。

blocks.en: Interestingly, even when global alignment fails, local spatial relations often remain consistent within limited neighborhoods. Points that are close in the tissue tend to preserve their relative configuration despite large-scale deformation or tearing. This observation suggests that correspondence can be established by modeling point-wise relationships to nearby landmarks, rather than estimating a single global transformation. Furthermore, coarse region-level retrieval followed by local refinement allows the system to progressively narrow down corresponding areas, even under severe deformation.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,即使全球协调失败,当地空间关系往往在有限的街区内保持不变。 组织中相近的点尽管有大规模变形或撕裂,但往往保持了相对的构型. 这一观察表明,可以通过对相邻地标的分点关系建模来建立对应关系,而不是估计一个单一的全球转型. 此外,粗细的区域一级检索,然后对当地加以改进,使得该系统即使在严重变形的情况下也能逐步缩小相应的区域。

blocks.en: Motivated by these insights, we introduce SAR2Net, a retrieval-guided framework that models geometric correspondence through learned spatial representations rather than explicit transformation prediction. SAR2Net encodes each point’s relative geometry with respect to automatically detected landmarks, which are treated as spatial anchors, forming representations that remain consistent across large cross-stain variations. Trained via contrastive learning on simulated coordinates without any image supervision, SAR2Net, coupled with a retrieval guided alignment pipeline, achieves robust region-level correspondence even under extreme deformations or tissue fragmentation, without requiring any pre-alignment.
blocks.zh: 基于这些见解,我们引入了SAR2Net,这是一个检索指导框架,通过了解的空间表示而不是明确的转换预测来模拟几何通信。 SAR2Net就自动探测到的地标编码了每个点的相对几何,这些地标被作为空间锚地处理,形成在大相径庭的变相上保持一致的表示. SAR2Net在模拟坐标上通过对比性学习而不受任何图像监督,加上一个取回导线对接管道,即使在极端变形或组织分解的情况下,也实现了强有力的区域级通信,而不需要任何预先对接。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold:
(1) We introduce SAR2Net, a network that models local geometric relations between spatial anchors and query points. The spatially anchored representations generated by SAR2Net achieve strong cross-stain robustness.
(2) We develop a two-stage retrieval pipeline that can establish region-level correspondences under extreme tissue distortion or fragment misalignment.
(3) We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on a biopsy-oriented cross-stain dataset, achieving reliable alignment in cases where traditional registration fails.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三:
(1)我们引入了SAR2Net,一个模拟空间锚地和查询点之间局部几何关系的网络. SAR2Net生成的空间定位表示具有强大的横跨性。
(2)我们开发出两阶段取回管道,可以在极端组织扭曲或片段错位的情况下建立区域一级的通信.
(3)我们展示在以活检为主的跨斑数据集上的先进表现,在传统注册失败的情况下实现可靠的对接.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Traditional WSI registration methods can be broadly categorized into intensity-based and feature-based approaches [ 9 ] .
Intensity-based methods directly exploit pixel-level information by optimizing similarity metrics like Mutual Information (MI) [ 5 , 8 ] , Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) [ 20 , 21 , 16 ] , and Normalized Gradient Fields (NGF) [ 19 , 17 ] .
In contrast, feature-based methods rely on the detection of salient local structures such as SIFT [ 23 , 27 , 14 ] and SURF [ 24 , 31 ] , followed by descriptor computation and sparse correspondence estimation.
However, due to strong stain variations, tissue deformations, and discontinuous tissue regions between WSI pairs, traditional methods often fail to achieve robust alignment.
blocks.zh:
WSI的传统登记方法可以大致分为以强度为基础的方法和以特征为基础的方法[9]。
基于强度的方法直接利用像素级信息,优化类似度度量,如:相互信息(MI)[5,8],正常化交叉校正(NCC)[20,21,16],正常化渐变场(NGF)[19,17]等.
相形之下,以特征为基础的方法依赖于对当地突出结构的检测,如SIFT[23,27,14]和SURF[24,31],然后是描述性计算和很少的函证估计.
然而,由于强烈的污点变异,组织变形,以及WSI配对之间的组织区域不连续,传统方法往往无法实现强相配.

blocks.en: To overcome the limitations of traditional methods, recent studies have employed deep learning models to extract more robust feature descriptors. CNN-based methods [ 2 , 12 , 3 ] learn discriminative representations from histopathological images and combine them with conventional matching algorithms for registration [ 4 ] . SuperPoint [ 7 ] further enables end-to-end keypoint detection and description, while SuperGlue [ 26 ] applies attention-based graph matching to establish reliable correspondences. The combination of SuperPoint and SuperGlue has been widely adopted in WSI registration. In addition, several pathology-specific approaches [ 18 , 15 ] detect nuclei as biologically meaningful keypoints to guide cross-stain alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了克服传统方法的局限性,最近的研究采用了深入的学习模式来取出更坚固的特征描述. 基于有线电视新闻网的方法[2,12,3]从组织病理学图像中学习出有区别的表示,并结合常规匹配算法进行注册[4]. SuperPoint [7] 进一步实现端到端的键点检测和描述,而SuperGlue [26] 应用基于注意的图表匹配来建立可靠的对应. SuperPoint和SuperGlue的组合在WSI注册中被广泛采用. 此外,有几种病理特异性的方法[18,15]检测出核是生物学上有意义的关键点来指导交叉相位对接.

blocks.en: Beyond learning feature descriptors, some methods aim to directly estimate transformation parameters, generating coarse affine alignments that are subsequently refined by non-rigid deformation models. For instance, Wodzinski et al . [ 29 ] employed a ResNet [ 13 ] to predict affine transformation parameters, while Roy et al . [ 25 ] generates multi-scale deformable vector fields using a FCN and additionally leverages a CycleGAN [ 32 ] to synthesize corresponding IHC slides from HE to assist registration. These parameter estimation approaches generally assume that slides can be roughly pre-aligned, which limits their applicability in cases with severe and complex tissue distortions.
blocks.zh: 除了学习特征描述符外,一些方法还旨在直接估计变形参数,生成粗细的外阴配合符,后被非刚性变形模型所精炼. 例如,Wodzinski等人. [29] 使用ResNet[13]来预测亲缘变换参数,而Roy等人. [25]利用FCN产生多尺度可变变活性矢量场,并另外利用CycleGAN[32]来合成HE的相应IHC幻灯片来协助注册. 这些参数估计方法一般认为,幻灯片大致可以预先对齐,这限制了其在组织严重而复杂的扭曲情况下的适用性.

blocks.en:
Currently, the most robust WSI registration approaches often adopt hybrid strategies that combine robust feature matching, global alignment, and local deformation refinement.
These multi-stage pipelines typically use descriptors like SuperPoint to perform initial registration,
followed by non-rigid refinement. For example, after initial registration, VALIS [ 11 ] conducts patch-wise optimization and obtains a dense deformation field by smoothly combining the local transformations, while RegWSI [ 28 ] performs non-rigid registration by optimizing local NCC at multiple scales. Such hybrid strategies leverage both structural correspondences and intensity cues, achieving stable and accurate alignment across heterogeneous HE-IHC slide pairs.
blocks.zh:
目前,最强有力的世界安全倡议登记办法往往采用混合战略,结合强有力的特征匹配、全球调整和当地变形的完善。
这些多阶段管道通常使用"超级点"(SuperPoint)等描述器进行初始注册,
之后是非刚性完善. 例如,在初始注册后,VALIS [11] 进行补丁优化,通过平稳地结合局部变换获得密集变形场;而RegWSI [28] 通过多尺度优化本地NCC来进行非刚性注册. 这种混合战略利用结构对应和强度提示,实现不同HE-IHC幻灯片对接的稳定和准确。

blocks.en:
However, all existing methods rely on the assumption that WSIs can be roughly pre-aligned.
If large tissue regions in HE and IHC slides do not roughly overlap after initial affine alignment, subsequent refinement or learned models often lack a reliable starting point, leading to registration failure. Such cases, caused by severe distortions or misaligned multi-tissue arrangements, are common in real-world pathological datasets, yet current research rarely address this challenge. In this work, we propose a method that circumvents the reliance on coarse pre-alignment, enabling robust alignment even under these difficult conditions.
blocks.zh:
然而,所有现有的方法都依赖于WSI可以大致被预先对齐的假设.
如果HE和IHC的大型组织区域在最初的亲和后没有大致重叠,那么后续的完善或学习模型往往缺乏可靠的起点,导致注册失败. 这种由严重扭曲或多问题安排错位所引发的情况在现实世界病理数据集中很常见,而目前的研究却很少针对这一挑战. 在这项工作中,我们提出一种方法,避免依赖粗糙的预先调整,即使在这些困难条件下,也能够进行有力的调整。

As detailed in Sec. 3.3 , for each source patch, nearby anchors are selected via Spatially Coherent Anchor Grouping. blocks.en: 3.2 Contrastive Learning of Spatial Geometry
blocks.zh: 3.2 空间几何的对照学习

blocks.en:
SAR2Net is trained to learn spatially anchored representations that depend solely on point coordinates rather than image appearance, encoding the geometric relations between a query point and its surrounding anchors.
Given K K anchors A = { a i } i = 1 K A=\{a_{i}\}_{i=1}^{K} and a query point x x , the network generates a representation f ⁡ ( x , A ) ∈ ℝ d f(x,A)\in\mathbb{R}^{d} that captures the query’s relative spatial configuration within the anchor set.

鉴于 K K 锚地 A = { a i } i = 1 K A=\{a_{i}\}_{i=i} 1}^{K } 并有一个查询点 x x , 网络生成一个能捕捉到被锚地集内查询相对空间配置的表示 f ⁡ (x, A) ∈ R d (x, A)\in\ mathbb{R}^{d }.

To learn such spatial representations, we adopt a contrastive training scheme using only simulated point coordinates. In each training iteration, we randomly sample K + 1 K+1 points, where K K points form the anchor set A A and the left one point serves as the query x x . A rigid transformation T ⁡ ( ⋅ ) T(\cdot) is applied to generate a positive pair ( ( x , A ) , ( T ⁡ ( x ) , T ⁡ ( A ) ) ) \left((x,A),(T(x),T(A))\right) , reflecting the same spatial structure.
Negatives are constructed by applying T ⁡ ( ⋅ ) T(\cdot) to the same anchor set A A and resampling N N negative query points { x j − } j = 1 N \{x_{j}^{-}\}_{j=1}^{N} that satisfy ‖ x j − − T ⁡ ( x ) ‖ > δ n ​ e ​ g \|x_{j}^{-}-T(x)\|>\delta_{neg} , ensuring sufficient geometric separation.

blocks.en:
When the query lies very close to an anchor, the model may focus excessively on anchor’s local neighborhood and neglect the overall anchor geometry. To address this, we employ local geometry–aware negative sampling (LGN) . As illustrated in Fig. 3 (a), the nearest anchor is treated as a reference, and a local convex hull is formed with its neighboring anchors. Negative queries are then sampled symmetrically on the opposite side of the hull, maintaining similar distances to the reference. In Fig. 3 (b), without LGN, the model tends to produce high similarity around both the reference anchor (black circle) and other anchors (red circle), effectively learning only that the query is near an anchor.
In Fig. 3 (c), with LGN, the high-similarity region in the black circle is constrained within the convex hull, while the similarity around the remaining anchors in the red circle is also suppressed.
At this point, the model captures more local spatial geometric information.
blocks.zh:
当查询离锚地非常近时,模型可能会过分地关注锚地的局部街区,忽略了整体锚地几何. 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了当地几何学的负取样法。 如图3(a)所示,最近的锚被作为参照物对待,并与其相邻的锚形成局部对流船体. 然后在船体对面对称地取样否定的查询,保持与参考物相近的距离. 在Fig. 3(b)中,没有LGN,模型往往在参考主播(黑圆)和其他主播(红圆)周围产生高度相似性,实际上只知道查询是靠近主播.
在图3(c)中,与LGN相通后,黑圈中高同质度的区域被限制在对流船体内部,而红圈中所剩锚地周围的相似性也被压制.
此时,模型能捕捉到更多的局部空间几何信息.

The network is trained with a standard InfoNCE loss.

blocks.en: 3.3 Retrieval-Guided Region Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.3 检索和指定区域对接

blocks.en:
To obtain spatially anchored representations, reliable spatial anchors are required as geometric reference points across stains.
We treat paired landmarks from source and target images as spatial anchors. We extract them by directly applying pre-trained SuperPoint and SuperGlue models on low-resolution slide thumbnails.
The SuperPoint-SuperGlue framework is known for its excellent generalization ability, enabling robust correspondence across different histopathological slides.
blocks.zh:
为了获得空间定位的表示,需要可靠的空间锚作为跨越污点的几何参考点。
我们把来自源头的对接地标和目标图像当作空间锚。 我们直接在低分辨率的幻灯片缩略图上应用预选的SuperPoint和SuperGlue模型来取出它们.
SuperPoint-SuperGlue框架以其出色的通俗化能力而出名,使得不同组织病理学幻灯片之间能够进行强力的对应.

blocks.en: However, both SuperPoint and SuperGlue lack rotation invariance, while tissue sections in WSIs may undergo various rotations. To address this, we rotate the source image by multiple angles and extract anchor points for each rotation. The rotation that yields the largest number of valid correspondences is selected, and its matched keypoints are used as the main anchor set ( A s ​ o ​ u ​ r ​ c ​ e , A t ​ a ​ r ​ g ​ e ​ t ) \left(A_{source},A_{target}\right) , where A s ​ o ​ u ​ r ​ c ​ e = { a i s } i = 1 K A_{source}=\{a_{i}^{s}\}_{i=1}^{K} and A t ​ a ​ r ​ g ​ e ​ t = { a i t } i = 1 K A_{target}=\{a_{i}^{t}\}_{i=1}^{K} .

blocks.en: Our region-level alignment assumes that the spatial relationship between a query and its nearby anchors remains locally stable across stains. However, large tissue deformations and discontinuities in WSIs often break this assumption, making global anchor sets unreliable for correspondence.
blocks.zh: 我们地区一级的调整假设,查询与附近锚地之间的空间关系在各地的污点上保持稳定。 然而,WSIs的大型组织变形和不连续经常会打破这一假设,使得全球锚集对通信不可靠.

blocks.en: To preserve spatial validity, we adopt a spatially coherent anchor grouping strategy. For each region to be aligned, we slide a window over the source slide and select up to K K nearest anchors within the window and its surrounding neighborhood, ensuring locally valid geometric relations.
blocks.zh: 为了保持空间有效性,我们采取空间一致的锚地组合战略。 对于要对齐的每个区域,我们将一个窗口从源幻灯片上滑出,并在窗口及其周围附近选择最接近KK锚地,确保本地有效的几何关系.

blocks.en: Still, anchors within the same window may not form a coherent structure, as some are mismatched, while others arise from separate tissue fragments or deformation patterns. To refine the grouping, we apply iterative geometric consensus using RANSAC [ 10 ] to cluster anchors that share a compatible local transformation, progressively discarding outliers until no valid model remains under the threshold δ s ​ p ​ l ​ i ​ t \delta_{split} . Each resulting subset serves as a stable geometric basis for subsequent region-level alignment.
blocks.zh: 然而,同一窗口内的锚可能不会形成一成不变的结构,因为有些是不匹配的,而另一些则出自于单独的组织碎片或变形模式. 为了完善组合,我们利用RANSAC[10]对具有相容局部变换的集群锚地采用迭代几何共识,逐渐丢弃外接器,直到没有有效的模型仍然处于- s s s s p l i t\ delta_{ split} 下. 由此产生的每个子集都为随后区域一级的调整提供了稳定的几何基础。

blocks.en: For each window, we compute spatially anchored representations for all points in both slides using same anchors. Region correspondence is then established through feature retrieval: for each target point, we map its similarity against all points in source slide and identify its top- k k most similar source points. If these points are concentrated within the corresponding source window mask, the target point is assigned to that region.
blocks.zh: 对于每个窗口,我们用同一个锚点计算两个幻灯片中所有点的空间定位表示。 然后通过特性检索建立区域函证:对于每个目标点,我们对照源幻灯片中的所有点来映射其相似性并识别其上-克最相近的源点. 如果这些点集中在相应的源窗口掩码内,则目标点被分配到该地区.

blocks.en: However, in some cases, the target region may have no true counterpart in the source slide due to tissue loss, fragmentation, or severe deformation. In such cases, the top- k k matches may still fall within nearby source areas but exhibit uniformly low similarity, leading to spurious correspondences. To prevent this, we introduce a similarity threshold δ s ​ i ​ m \delta_{sim} and only assign a region label when the maximum similarity exceeds this value. This filtering step effectively suppresses false matches and enhances the reliability of cross-stain region alignment.
blocks.zh: 然而,在某些情况下,目标区域可能由于组织损耗,分解或严重变形等原因,在源幻灯片中没有真正的对应物. 在这种情况下,顶-k k 匹配可能仍然属于相邻的源地,但呈现出一致的低等相似性,导致虚假的函证. 为了防止这种情况,我们引入了相近性阈值 \ s s i\ delta\ sim } 并且只在最大相近性超过此值时指定一个区域标签 。 这一过滤步骤有效压制了假匹配,并增强了跨相片区域对接的可靠性.

blocks.zh: 图4: 二阶精进. 第二阶段的改进工作在每个地区进行,其邻近地区从第一阶段的检索中获得。 QQ\circ表示从第一阶段开始的错配区域,这些错配区域经过完善后成功纠正.

blocks.en: After the first round of retrieval, our model has already established a reliable region-level correspondence. However, due to the large window size and sparse anchor distribution, local areas may still exhibit slight nonlinear deformations or boundary shifts, limiting alignment precision. To further refine local correspondence, we introduce a two-stage refinement strategy. Specifically, as illustrated in Fig. 4 , each matched region from the first stage is treated as a new region of interest (ROI), within which additional anchors are extracted to form denser and more locally consistent anchor sets. The region alignment process is then re-applied within these refined ROIs. Built upon the initial region-level mapping, this hierarchical refinement progressively enhances alignment accuracy and stability under complex tissue deformations.
blocks.zh: 在第一轮检索之后,我们的模型已经建立了可靠的区域一级的通信。 然而,由于窗口面积大而锚地分布稀疏,局部地区仍可能呈现出轻微的非线性变形或边界起伏,限制了对接精度. 为进一步完善地方公文,我们实行两阶段完善战略. 具体地说,如图4所示,第一阶段的每个匹配区域都被视为一个新的感兴趣区域(ROI),在这一区域中取出更多的锚来形成更密集、更一致的地方锚地。 然后,在经过改进的《规则》中重新应用区域协调进程。 这种分级的改进是在初步的区域一级测绘基础上建立的,在复杂的组织变形下,逐步提高校正准确性和稳定性。

blocks.zh: 4 数据集

blocks.en: 4.1 Data collection and cleaning
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据收集和清理

blocks.en: We collect histopathology slides from Xijing Hospital. Approximately 35 % \% of these slides exhibit severe tissue distortions or consisted of multiple disjoint tissue fragments, characteristics commonly observed in biopsy specimens. From the raw collection, we select 154 cases that contain both HE and IHC slides, ensuring that at least part of the tissue regions in each HE slide have corresponding areas in the IHC counterpart. In some cases, one HE slide is associated with multiple IHC slides (up to over ten). For cases with more than three corresponding IHC slides, we randomly select up to three to maintain data diversity and computational feasibility. In total, we obtain 370 HE–IHC slide pairs covering 79 different IHC staining types. Our dataset spans diverse tissues and cancer types, with 23.6% from breast, 15.7% from liver, and 14.6% from prostate.

blocks.en: 4.2 Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 数据注释

blocks.en: Considering that region-level alignment is often sufficient for diagnostic interpretation, we annotated our 370 HE–IHC pairs at the region level. We first performed automatic tissue–background segmentation to accelerate the subsequent annotation process. The segmentation was conducted using the tissue segmentation module from Trident [ 30 ] , which is robust across various staining types and does not require manual parameter tuning as in traditional threshold-based approaches. After segmentation, we manually delineated corresponding tissue regions, ensuring that each annotated region was complete and consistently present in both HE and IHC slides. Fig. 5 illustrates examples of the annotated region correspondences.
blocks.zh: 考虑到区域一级的配合往往足以进行诊断性解释,我们注解了我们在区域一级的370对HE-IHC配对。 我们首先进行了组织-背面自动分解,以加速随后的注释过程。 分解使用三叉戟[30]的组织分解模块进行,这种分解跨越了各种污渍类型,不需要像传统的以阈值为基础的方法那样进行人工参数调整。 经过分解后,我们手动划定了相应的组织区域,以确保每个附加说明的区域都是完整的,并始终如一地出现在HE和IHC幻灯片中. 图5举例说明了附加说明的区域信函。

blocks.en: 5.1 Implementation Details

blocks.en: During training, we use simulated 2D coordinates to enable SAR2Net to learn spatial relationships between query and anchor points. The output embedding dimension d d is 256. With a batch size of 256, the number of spatial anchors K K is fixed within a batch but randomly sampled from { 4 , … , 10 } \{4,\dots,10\} across batches. For negative sampling, we set the minimum separation distance δ n ​ e ​ g = 20 \delta_{neg}=20 and draw N = 500 N=500 negative queries for each sample. To encourage the network to reason about local geometric boundaries, 10 % \% of query points are sampled near anchors, for which additional negatives are placed symmetrically on the opposite side of the convex hull, as described in Sec. 3.2 . For all sampled coordinates, a uniform perturbation ϵ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( − 5 , 5 ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{U}(-5,5) is added to improve robustness. The model is trained with the Adam optimizer using a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and the InfoNCE loss [ 22 ] with temperature τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 计量

blocks.en: To systematically evaluate the region-alignment performance, we report the mean intersection over union (mIoU) and mean dice similarity coefficient (mDice). blocks.en: We compare our SAR2Net with two recent leading WSI alignment frameworks: VALIS [ 11 ] and RegWSI [ 28 ] . Both VALIS and RegWSI are fully automated, multi-stage WSI registration frameworks that perform feature-based rigid or affine initialization followed by intensity-based non-rigid refinement. We evaluate all methods on our biopsy dataset to assess their performance under severe tissue discontinuities and deformations.

blocks.en: 5.4 Quantitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.4 定量比较

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 1 , our method achieves substantial improvements over existing approaches across all four metrics (mIoU, mDice, aw-IoU, and aw-Dice). This demonstrates that the proposed alignment framework is considerably more effective than traditional registration pipelines. Moreover, incorporating the second-round refinement yields additional and consistent gains over the single-round variant, confirming the effectiveness of our iterative retrieval-and-refinement strategy for correcting residual misalignments.
blocks.zh: 如附件1所示,我们的方法在所有四个衡量标准(mIoU、mDice、aw-IoU和aw-Dice)上比现有方法有了很大的改进。 这表明,拟议的统一框架比传统的登记管道有效得多。 此外,纳入第二轮调整后,在单一轮变式上取得了更多和一致的成果,证实了我们纠正剩余错位的迭接检索和精减战略的有效性。

blocks.en:
For previous methods such as VALIS and RegWSI, the area weighted metrics are slightly higher than the mean metrics, which is mainly driven by the correct alignment of a few large and easier-to-match regions. This indicates an imbalance in their alignment behavior: while large regions are aligned reasonably well, many medium and small regions remain poorly aligned.
Such imbalance stems from the tendency of these registration frameworks to rely heavily on the initial alignment stage, which often prioritizes the global fit of larger regions at the expense of smaller ones. As a result, these methods struggle to maintain robustness once the geometric structure becomes locally complex.
blocks.zh:
对于VALIS和RegWSI等前作方法,面积加权度量度略高于平均度量度,而平均度量值主要由少数大而更方便相匹配的地区的正确对接所驱动. 这表明它们的配对行为不平衡:虽然大区域配对程度相当好,但许多中小区域仍不配对。
这种不平衡源于这些登记框架严重依赖初始调整阶段的趋势,这种调整阶段往往以较小的区域为代价,优先考虑大区域的全球适应性。 因此,一旦几何结构变得局部复杂,这些方法就难以维持稳健性.

blocks.en: In contrast, our method still exhibits a markedly larger advantage on the area weighted metrics and, more importantly, shows only minimal discrepancy between mean based metrics and area weighted metrics. This indicates that our alignment quality is uniformly high across regions of different sizes, rather than being biased toward large regions. Such closeness between the mean and area weighted metrics highlights the size-robustness of our framework and demonstrates that it maintains stable and reliable alignment performance for both large and small regions.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,我们的方法在地区加权度量标准方面仍然显示出明显更大的优势,更重要的是,我们的方法显示,基于平均度量标准与地区加权度量标准之间的差别很小。 这表明,在不同地区,我们的调整质量一致地很高,而不是偏向大区域。 平均和地区加权计量之间的这种密切性突出了我们框架的大小波动性,并表明它保持了大小区域稳定和可靠的调整业绩。

blocks.en: 5.5 Robustness Analysis with Success Rate
blocks.zh: 5.5 强性分析与成功率

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 2 , our method achieves substantially higher success rates than existing approaches across different IoU and Dice thresholds. This indicates that, compared with previous registration pipelines, our retrieval–alignment framework maintains a much larger proportion of high-quality aligned regions, yielding more stable and robust performance overall. Moreover, the second-round refinement brings additional improvements across all SR metrics, particularly at higher thresholds, demonstrating its effectiveness in correcting the residual misalignments left by the first round and improving performance in difficult regions.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所显示. 2,我们的方法实现的成功率大大高于不同IoU和Dice阈值的现有方法. 这表明,与以往的登记管道相比,我们的检索-调整框架在高质量对接区域中维持了更大比例,总体表现更加稳定和有力。 此外,第二轮的改进使所有衡量标准都有了新的改进,特别是在更高的阈值方面,这表明它有效地纠正了第一轮遗留的错位,改善了困难地区的业绩。

blocks.en: This trend is further corroborated by the success rate curves in Fig. 6 . The AUC values shown in the figure reveal that our method consistently maintains higher SR curves across the entire range of thresholds, highlighting its advantage across regions of varying difficulty. In contrast, VALIS and RegWSI exhibit highly unstable behavior when reliable initial alignment is unavailable: many regions fall below even moderate IoU/Dice thresholds, and VALIS even collapses entirely on certain samples, underscoring the vulnerability of previous frameworks under large deformations and complex local structures. The gains from our second round refinement concentrate in the high threshold ranges, 0.7-0.9 for IoU and 0.8-0.9 for Dice, which aligns well with our design: the first round retrieval in SAR2Net establishes a strong global correspondence, while the second round refinement corrects fine-scale nonlinear distortions and boundary shifts remaining from the first round, thus increasing the proportion of high-quality matches.
blocks.zh: 图中的成功率曲线进一步证实了这一趋势。 6,图中显示的AUC值显示,我们的方法在整个阈值范围内始终保持较高的SR曲线,突出其跨有不同难度的区域的优势. 相形之下,VALIS和RegWSI在无法可靠地进行初始对接时表现出非常不稳定的行为:许多地区甚至低于中度IoU/Dice阈值,而VALIS甚至完全在某些样本上倒塌,凸显出以往框架在大变形和复杂局部结构下的脆弱性. 我们第二轮完善的成果集中于高阈值范围,IoU为0.7-0.9,Dice为0.8-0.9,这与我们的设计十分一致:SAR2Net的第一轮检索建立了强有力的全球对应关系,而第二轮完善则纠正了第一轮遗留下来的细度非线性扭曲和边界转移,从而提高了高质量匹配的比例。

blocks.en: Together, Tab. 2 and Fig. 6 demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior average overlap performance, but also delivers a more stable and consistent alignment quality distribution. It maintains reliable performance across regions of different sizes and difficulty levels, significantly outperforming existing WSI registration approaches.
blocks.zh: Tab. 2和图6一起表明,我们的方法不仅实现了优异的平均重叠性能,而且提供了更稳定和更一致的对接质量分布. 它在不同规模和困难程度的区域保持可靠的业绩,显著地超过现有的世界安全倡议登记办法。

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 3 , random perturbations provide the most significant performance gains. Incorporating perturbations during training leads to large improvements in mIoU, mDice, and aw-IoU, indicating substantially enhanced robustness to large and nonlinear deformations. This observation is fully consistent with the success rate curves in Fig. 9 : without perturbations , the SR curves drop sharply in the mid-to-high threshold ranges ( e.g . 0.7–0.9), whereas the curves with perturbations remain consistently higher across all thresholds, demonstrating more reliable retrieval of the correct corresponding region.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所显示. 3,随机扰动提供最显著的业绩收益. 培训过程中的扰动导致mIoU、mDice和aw-IoU的大幅改进,表明对大型和非线性变形的强性大为增强。 这种观察与图9中的成功率曲线完全一致:没有扰动,SR曲线在中高阈值范围(如:0.7–0.9)会急剧下降,而有扰动的曲线在所有阈值上始终保持较高水平,显示了对正确对应区域的更可靠的检索.

blocks.en: The similarity maps in Fig. 7 further illustrate this effect. Without perturbations, the model exhibits clear concentric interference patterns, and the highlighted region collapses into a narrow neighborhood around the query–anchor distance, revealing an undesired tendency toward rigid matching. In contrast, when random perturbations are applied, the model still correctly identifies the corresponding position, but the activation becomes much smoother and more spatially flexible, better reflecting the nonlinear deformations commonly observed in real WSI pairs. This confirms that random perturbations effectively prevent the network from overfitting to rigid transformations and encourage the learning of more realistic geometric variations.
blocks.zh: 图7中的相似性图进一步说明了这种效果. 在没有扰动的情况下,模型显示出明显的同心干涉模式,突出的区域倒塌成一个狭小的邻里,周围是查询-锚地距离,揭示出一种不可取的僵硬匹配趋势。 相形之下,当随机扰动被应用时,模型仍然正确识别出相应的位置,但活化会变得更平滑更灵活,更能更好地反映在真实的WSI对中常见的非线性变形. 这证实了随机扰动有效防止了网络过度适应刚性变换,并鼓励学习更现实的几何变化.

blocks.en: As for the local geometry-aware negative sampling, it plays a more localized and fine-grained role. Adding LGN leads to modest improvements in mIoU and mDice, while at the same time, the SR curves with and without LGN nearly overlap in Fig. 9 . This indicates that LGN mainly enhances boundary-level geometric discrimination when the query lies close to certain anchors, but has limited influence on the overall large-region alignment.

blocks.en: Finally, incorporating the second-round refinement yields small yet consistent improvements in both average metrics and high-threshold SR values, leading to the best overall performance. This stage refines the residual mis-alignments left by the first round and adjusts boundary details, resulting in more precise final alignment.
blocks.zh: 最后,纳入第二轮改进,使平均衡量和高门槛的SR值都得到小而一致的改善,从而取得最佳的总体业绩。 这一阶段完善了第一回合遗留下来的残存错位并调整了边界细节,使得最终对齐更为精确.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present SAR2Net, a framework that learns spatially anchored representations for cross-stain region alignment. By modeling the relative geometric relationships between query points and surrounding anchors, SAR2Net enables cross-slide correspondence without any pre-alignment. Through contrastive learning on simulated point coordinates, retrieval-guided region alignment, and multi-level refinement, our method remains robust to severe deformations and fragmented tissue. Experimental results demonstrate that SAR2Net consistently outperforms existing registration frameworks, offering a new perspective for multi-stain integration in computational pathology.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍SAR2Net,这是一个学习跨区域协调空间定位表述的框架。 SAR2Net通过模拟查询点和周围锚点之间的相对几何关系,使得可以不作任何预对齐地进行相通相通. 通过模拟点坐标的对比性学习,取回-导区域对接,以及多层次的完善,我们的方法仍然坚固到严重变形和分裂的组织. 实验结果表明,SAR2Net的业绩一贯高于现有的登记框架,为多领域结合计算病理提供了新的视角。
